literal_meaning: উঠল (got up), বাই (went out), তো (then), কটক যাই (go to Katak/Cuttack)
figurative_meaning_en: Hasty decision without opportunity for deliberation
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে উঠল বাই তো কটক যাই করে চাকরি ছেড়ে দিল।
ব্যবসায়ে উঠল বাই তো কটক যাই করলে লোকসান হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He jumped the gun and quit his job without thinking twice.
Making a hasty decision in business leads to losses.
note: Refers to impulsive travel to Katak (possibly Cuttack), symbolizing rash actions in Bengali folklore
